profile.reading: This OpenStreetMap record is tagged with the operator name CenturyLink, the legacy brand of the telecommunications company now operating as Lumen Technologies, which formally renamed itself in September 2020. Atlanta's 56 Marietta Street and adjacent downtown carrier-hotel buildings have long served as major regional telecom interconnection points, and CenturyLink/Lumen's Atlanta presence, inherited through a long chain of legacy mergers (US West, Qwest, Embarq, and others absorbed into what became CenturyLink before the 2020 Lumen rebrand), likely includes both purpose-built colocation space and older central-office infrastructure; no evidence located this session distinguishes which category this specific record falls into.
